literal_meaning: নাক গলিয়ে দেওয়া (to poke or insert the nose)
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই ব্যবসায়ে আমি নাক গলাতে চাই।
তুমি এই বিষয়ে কেন নাক গলাচ্ছ না?
example_sentences_in_english: I want to poke my nose into this business.
Why aren't you showing interest in this matter?
note: The idiom is often used in everyday Bengali speech to indicate positive curiosity or engagement, though it can carry a nuance of mild intrusion in some contexts.
